newsitem.title: UK: Boots appoints new stores director.
newsitem.headline: Boots appoints new stores director.

text.p: British pharmacist and high street chemist chain Boots Co Plc said it had appointed Martin Bryant to be director of stores at its retail chain Boots the Chemist (BTC), replacing Ron Glaister who retired earlier this year.
Stephen Murray, director of leisure businesses at BTC, will replace Bryant as managing director of Boots Opticians.
Murray's leisure business post will be filled by Peter Burdon, who is currently director of business development at BTC.
David Roberts will become BTC's new business development director.
All new appointments will be effective June 1, Boots said in a statement.
